flashcard_questions.q: How do decomposers break down dead organic material?
flashcard_questions.a: They secrete enzymes that digest large molecules into soluble ones.

flashcard_questions.q: Which two elements does the decay cycle recycle for living organisms?
What happens to a decomposer's enzyme above its optimum temperature?
flashcard_questions.a: It is denatured, so the substrate no longer fits the active site.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do dry conditions slow decomposition down?
flashcard_questions.a: Water is needed to secrete enzymes and absorb the digested products.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does more oxygen speed decomposition up?
Which variable is changed in the lipase investigation of decay?
Which mineral ions in compost make it useful as a fertiliser?
Which gas is the main product of a biogas generator?
Which respiration conditions are needed inside a biogas generator?

flashcard_questions.a: Having enough safe, nutritious food to feed a population at all times.

flashcard_questions.q: Why are shorter food chains more efficient for producing food?
flashcard_questions.a: Less biomass is lost between trophic levels.
A limit on how many fish can be caught in an area.

flashcard_questions.q: Which fungus is grown in fermenters to make mycoprotein?
What is the food source for the fungus in a mycoprotein fermenter?
Which structure carries a gene into plant cells in genetic engineering?
flashcard_questions.a: A plasmid, acting as a vector.
